name: yupana_repository_ideas
template: PREFIX a: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT * WHERE { ?s a a:Concept; rdfs:comment ?summary . FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?s), "http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/yupana/") || STRSTARTS(STR(?s), "http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/yupana/")) } ORDER BY ?s LIMIT 100

name: yupana_repository_interfaces
template: PREFIX a: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT * WHERE { ?s a:interfaceKind ?kind; a:publicName ?name . FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?s), "http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/yupana/") || STRSTARTS(STR(?s), "http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/yupana/")) } ORDER BY ?s LIMIT 100

name: yupana_repository_decisions
template: PREFIX a: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT * WHERE { ?s a a:DecisionRecord; a:status ?status . OPTIONAL { ?s <http://purl.org/dc/terms/isReplacedBy> ?successor } FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?s), "http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/yupana/") || STRSTARTS(STR(?s), "http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/yupana/")) } ORDER BY ?s LIMIT 100

name: yupana_repository_start_here
template: PREFIX a: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT * WHERE { ?s a:startHereOrder ?order . FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?s), "http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/yupana/") || STRSTARTS(STR(?s), "http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/yupana/")) } ORDER BY ?s LIMIT 100

name: yupana_repository_freshness
template: PREFIX a: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT * WHERE { ?s a:reviewAfter ?reviewAfter; a:maxAge ?maxAgeSeconds . FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?s), "http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/yupana/") || STRSTARTS(STR(?s), "http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/yupana/")) } ORDER BY ?s LIMIT 100
